partnerPage.heroDesc: BidVex provides licensed auctioneers, bankruptcy trustees, and liquidators with a modern platform to run their sales — at a flat 3% platform fee.

partnerPage.benefit2Desc: Full control over your margin. Configure custom buyer premium rates per auction — 10%, 15%, 18%, or any rate.
partnerPage.benefit3Desc: Stand out with a trust badge on every listing. Show buyers they are dealing with a licensed professional.
partnerPage.benefit4Desc: Hammer price and buyer premium are transferred directly to your bank. No waiting, no intermediaries.

policies.subtitle: Buyer & Seller Terms for Quebec Storage Liens
policies.sectionAsIsBody: All storage unit contents are sold AS-IS, WHERE-IS. Photos shown are samples; actual contents may differ. Buyer accepts all risks. No warranties express or implied. No refunds after auction close (except deposit refunds for non-winning bidders).
policies.sectionLienBody: Storage units are auctioned under the operator's right of lien for unpaid rent. The Quebec Civil Code (Article 2767+) governs lien-holder rights in residential and commercial storage. The operator has issued public notice, observed holding periods, and confirmed rights of redemption.

legalShield.title: Why This Agreement Matters
legalShield.subtitle: Your protection as a seller on BidVex
legalShield.card1Body: By accepting these terms, your buyer cannot claim refunds based on item condition after the sale closes. Photos and descriptions form the entire warranty.
legalShield.card2Body: Sellers are bound to sell to the highest legitimate bidder. Refusal to honor the winning bid violates BidVex terms and may result in account suspension.
legalShield.card3Body: Buyer must arrange pickup within the timeframe you set. After that, the item is considered abandoned and you may relist or dispose of it without refund.
legalShield.card4Body: Stripe captures the buyer's payment immediately on auction close. Funds settle to your account within 2 business days minus BidVex commission.
legalShield.card5Body: BidVex auctions operate under the Quebec Consumer Protection Act. Bilingual disclosures, deposit refund rules, and cooling-off periods are enforced platform-wide.
legalShield.card6Body: BidVex provides built-in dispute mediation for non-conforming items, no-show buyers, and payment failures. Cases are reviewed within 5 business days.
legalShield.importantContractIntro: This agreement serves as your legal contract with the buyer. Providing accurate details protects you from disputes and ensures a smooth payout.
legalShield.logisticsExampleBody: If you state "Forklift Available" and cannot provide one at pickup, you may be liable for the buyer's specialized transport costs.
legalShield.refundsExampleBody: Explicitly marking an item "Non-Refundable" protects your sale if a buyer has "buyer's remorse" after winning.
legalShield.removalExampleBody: Setting a 7-day removal deadline allows you to legally charge storage fees or relist the item if the buyer fails to pick it up on time.
legalShield.sellerCommitmentBody: By listing this item, I certify that all location, logistics, and refund information provided is accurate and binding. I understand that providing false or misleading information may result in penalties, dispute liability, and removal from the platform.
legalShield.mustConfirmSellerCommitment: You must confirm the seller commitment to proceed
